guidance: Create one project-owned document titled `Project Development Guide`. The imported Agile Project Development Guide supplies the proposed defaults; this template supplies shape only. Render the document title as H1, fixed Purpose and Adoption and Standards as H2, included concerns as H3, and their keyed Adoption subsections as H4. Keep the stable keys. Include only concerns applicable to this repository, omit empty concerns, and preserve unrelated existing sections on update. Each included concern needs its keyed Adoption subsection with `Status: Draft` or `Status: Approved` and `Applies to`. Approved records an accepted future convention, not a claim that all existing code complies. Keep a prior Approved decision identifiable while a proposed revision remains Draft. Do not invent repository facts, rules, or approval.

outline.title: Purpose and Adoption
outline.guidance: Name the repository, the guide's scope, the difference between Draft and Approved section status, and how applicable rules govern new or touched code. State that product requirements and explicit team decisions take precedence. Include a compact index of included concern keys and applicability so later tasks can select concerns without reading Standards. Keep this concise and project-specific. Do not nest concern sections here.

outline.title: Standards
outline.guidance: Container for only the concerns applicable to this repository. Each included concern is independently keyed and has its keyed Adoption subsection.
